historyDescription: Since 2003, SARI Système has been supporting healthcare professionals in their quest for excellence
historyP1: Founded in 2003, SARI Système has become in a few years an essential player in the distribution of medical equipment in France. Our mission: to provide healthcare professionals with the best tools to practice their profession with excellence.
historyP2: With more than 500 active clients and a team of 50 passionate experts, we continue every day to innovate and exceed ourselves to meet the growing needs of the medical sector.
